**Finding: missing** (INSURANCE — Vendor insurance)

- **Investigation:** A literal search for "insurance" returned zero hits, and a full read of the single-section MSA confirmed no coverage obligation exists — not in Section 10 (Indemnification), Section 11 (Indemnification Procedures), or Section 14 (General Provisions).
- **Why it matters:** Kubient is a hosting/ad-tech services vendor that, per its own warranty in Section 9(b)(iii), collects, maintains, manages and stores visitor information (data) and operates the Auction Platform. A data-processing vendor with no insurance backing its broad Section 10(a) indemnity sits in the rule's walk-away territory, not merely below the fallback.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Inserted a new Section 14(j) at the preferred position — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber liability USD 5M where Customer data is processed, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates of insurance on request, surviving one year post-Term. Placement after paragraph 14(i) keeps the existing lettering sequence intact and sits ahead of the signature block.
- **Negotiation posture:** The comment offers the fallback limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) as an express landing zone, so this should be a low-friction addition given the severity is low.
